sentences.text: This criminal miscellaneous case is filed to quash the FIR in Crime No.1285/2017 of Palarivattom Police Station.
Even though there was an order not to arrest the petitioners, the same was not extended.
Probably the final report in this case might have been filed.
If the final report is filed and the petitioners are aggrieved by the same, they are free to challenge the same in accordance with law.
With the above observation, this criminal miscellaneous case is disposed of.
